optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Customer Success Manager, Analytics Software Accounts

professionalSummary.text: Customer Success Manager with three years of experience at an analytics software company managing mid-market accounts, running quarterly business reviews under the team's review format, and presenting adoption findings to customer executives.
professionalSummary.witness: Customer success manager at an analytics software company for three years, running the quarterly business reviews for a book of twenty-two mid-market accounts under the team's review format. Presented the adoption findings and recommendations to the accounts' executives in each review; the review records carry the attendees and the actions agreed, and the customer executives' post-review survey scored the presentations at or above the team average in every quarter.

experienceHighlights.text: Managed a book of twenty-two mid-market accounts, running quarterly business reviews under the team's review format with consistent executive satisfaction as measured by post-review surveys.
experienceHighlights.witness: Customer success manager at an analytics software company for three years, running the quarterly business reviews for a book of twenty-two mid-market accounts under the team's review format. experienceHighlights.text: Tracked adoption against success plans in the customer success platform, with monthly reviews of plans with the head of customer success.
experienceHighlights.witness: Tracked adoption against each account's success plan in the customer success platform, with the plans reviewed monthly with the head of customer success.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated renewals with account executives through a renewal tracker, documenting preparation responsibilities while pricing decisions remained with the account executives.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated renewals with the account executives through the renewal tracker; the pricing decisions were the account executives', and the tracker records which preparation was mine.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented open items and hand-over conditions for each account at quarter end, using standardized notes.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the open items note and the hand-over conditions for each account at each quarter end.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided two quarterly business review records with attendees, actions, and survey scores, one success plan, and a renewal tracker extract for verification.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: two quarterly business review records with attendees, actions and survey scores, one success plan and the renewal tracker extract for one quarter, with the customer success platform references as a verification trail.

skills.text: Customer success platform proficiency, adoption tracking, renewal coordination, executive presentation, and documentation of open items.
